purpose: Example capability manifest for the internal Sifututor Agent OS. Do not store secrets here.

capability_states.available: Tool is connected and verified in this session.
capability_states.fallback: Primary tool path is broken, but a safe alternate path works.
capability_states.unknown: Tool has not been checked yet.
capability_states.not_connected: Tool is absent in this session.
capability_states.blocked: Tool exists, but approval or risk gate prevents use now.
capability_states.exception_only: Tool is outside the default Agent OS path and may be used only when Hafiz explicitly asks in the current session.
capability_states.forbidden: Never allowed by Agent OS rules.

tools.git_commit: blocked: requires exact file-list approval and guard checks

context_authority.verified: Checked against current source, evidence, command output, runtime data, or official source.
context_authority.trusted: Approved docs, task state, or memory that has not been rechecked yet.
context_authority.reported: User, staff, support, Planner, customer report, or screenshot.
context_authority.historical: Old Koda memory, handoff, snapshot, commit note, or prior chat summary.
